fusions.name: Outrider Dart
fusions.desc: A thrown stinger that deals 4 damage, rising to 2.5 times that at maximum range. Its damage rises 5% per 100 paces you run since you last used it (max +25%).

fusions.name: Column Volley
fusions.desc: Looses 5 stingers in a wide fan, each dealing 12 damage. Whenever one hits, your allies deal 20% more damage for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Marching Song
fusions.desc: Restores 3 stamina a second for 8 seconds, and your movement speed rises 20% for 4 seconds after you use it. A column of stingers fights beside you for 12 seconds, striking for 3 every 1.4 seconds.

fusions.name: Steady Tramp
fusions.desc: Your movement speed is permanently increased by 10%. A column of stingers fights beside you, striking for 3 every 1.4 seconds for 8 seconds.
